headline: Maui Planning Commission

meeting.summary: The Maui Planning Commission reviewed South Maui Community Plan growth areas and will continue the Promenade land-use discussion in two weeks.
meeting.recap: The Maui Planning Commission met November 12, 2024, to continue reviewing the South Maui Community Plan.[[0:00:34]] The focus was the growth framework for sub area 1 and sub area 2, North Kīhei.[[0:02:25]] A ranch representative objected to requiring the whole collector road before any house is built.[[1:12:49]] Commissioners agreed to show each sub area's background in tables instead of paragraphs.[[2:31:38]] The planning department said the plan cannot place industrial land outside the urban growth boundary.[[2:34:39]] A commissioner worried "small town center" could allow mostly commercial building.[[3:44:01]] The commission will continue this discussion at its meeting two weeks from now.[[3:45:03]]
decided: Commissioners agreed by consensus that sub area descriptions, including history, go in table form; no vote was taken.
meeting.next: The planning department said it can label the project areas on the area of change map. The chair asked commissioners to read what each land use designation allows before the next meeting.

moments.q: "our lane here is this community plan"
